description: Exact keyword (full-text) search across Swiss court decisions on entscheidsuche.ch. Finds decisions that contain the given words. Use it for specific terms, statute articles, names, quoted phrases, complete result lists, sorting by date and pagination. For legal questions in natural language prefer `semantic_search`. Search syntax (Lucene query string): - All terms must occur (default operator AND). - Phrase: "dringender Eigenbedarf" (double quotes). - Boolean operators in capitals between terms: AND, OR, NOT. - Wildcards: * and ? — '*' alone matches every decision. - Statute citations work as written: Art. 271 OR, Art. 8 ZGB. - Put case numbers in quotes ("5A_396/2015") or use `search_by_case_number`. If a query is not valid syntax it is searched as plain terms and the response says so in `note`. `text` contains a snippet with the matched terms in …. A hit contains only an excerpt of the decision, not the decision. Before you state what a decision holds, describe its outcome or quote from it, read its full text with `fetch` (or `fetch_document`), passing the hit's `id`. Filters are combined with AND. Hierarchy IDs (canton / court / chamber, e.g. 'CH_BGer', 'ZH_OG') are case-sensitive; take them from `list_hierarchy` or `list_facets`. Pagination: pass `next_cursor` of the response as `search_after` in the next call (same query, same sort).

hierarchy.description: Restrict to cantons, courts or chambers by hierarchy ID, e.g. ['CH_BGer'] or ['ZH_OG', 'BE']. Several IDs are combined with OR.
hierarchy.title: Hierarchy

include_aggregations.description: Also return distributions of the results by court, language and date.
include_aggregations.title: Include Aggregations

language.description: Preferred language (de, fr, it) for the displayed title and abstract. Does NOT filter — use `language_filter` for that.

language_filter.description: Only decisions written in these languages, e.g. ['fr'].
language_filter.title: Language Filter

query.description: Search terms. "..." for phrases, AND/OR/NOT for Boolean operators, * and ? for wildcards. "*" matches everything.
query.title: Query

scrape_date_from.description: Earliest date the decision was added to the index (YYYY-MM-DD).
scrape_date_from.title: Scrape Date From

scrape_date_to.description: Latest date the decision was added to the index (YYYY-MM-DD).
scrape_date_to.title: Scrape Date To

search_after.description: Cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous response.
search_after.title: Search After

sort.description: Sort order: 'relevance' (default) | 'date' (decision date, newest first) | 'scrapedate' (date added to the index, newest first).
sort.title: Sort

name: keyword_search

ResultRef.description: Kompakter Treffer-Verweis (id, title, url) für Clients, die genau dieses Format erwarten.
ResultRef.title: ResultRef

content_length.description: Length of the indexed full text in characters. Only set by `fetch_document`.
content_length.title: Content Length

context.description: Semantic search with `include_context=true` only: the larger section of the decision (up to about 6,000 characters) that contains the passage in `text`.
context.title: Context

document_url.description: Direct download link to the original document.
document_url.title: Document Url

original_url.description: URL of the original source web page.
original_url.title: Original Url

score.description: Semantic search only: similarity between the query and the best matching passage of this decision (higher is better).
score.title: Score

sort.description: Sort values of the hit (for search_after).
sort.title: Sort

text.description: Excerpt from the decision. Keyword search: highlight snippet with the matched terms wrapped in …. Semantic search: the passage of the decision that best matches the query. `fetch_document`: the full text.
text.title: Text

text_truncated.description: True if the indexed full text was truncated by Elasticsearch at 100,000 characters. In that case `text` contains only the beginning of the decision; the complete document is available at `document_url`.
text_truncated.title: Text Truncated

url.description: Web page of the decision on entscheidsuche.ch (use this link for citations).
url.title: Url

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Pass it again as `search_after` in the next request. None if there are no further results.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

note.description: Remarks on how the query was executed, e.g. that it was not valid search syntax and was searched as plain terms.
note.title: Note

results.description: Only set by the `search` tool: compact list (id, title, url) of the same decisions as in `hits`, in the same order.
results.title: Results

total.description: Keyword search: number of all matching decisions. Semantic search: number of decisions among the best-matching passages.
total.title: Total

title: Keyword search (exact terms)
